method.hash: imagehash dhash hash_size=16 (256 bits) on the site image composited on white; art crop = x 8-92%, y 12-60% of the card
method.rule: the hash proposes which illustration (art cluster); the printing's variant label plus the reviewer's read decides stamped versus unstamped. Nothing about stamps is inferred from a hash.
method.whole_card_stamp_separation: over the lane's 28 jp/cn base printings (14 jp + 14 cn, the jp _r1 reprint excluded), the nearest design on whole-card dhash16 was a STAMPED design in 4 of 28 (OP10-028 jp and cn, EB04-006 jp, OP12-078 cn); stamped-minus-unstamped margin -4 to +5 bits. Cause: each site prints its own SAMPLE watermark and card text over the art.
method.art_crop_recolour_separation: OP17 cards (base vs sepia _p1 recolour, 6 cards): art-crop margin recolour-minus-base is 1 to 32 bits for cn base and 2 to 34 bits for jp base; at the low end the eye decides.
method.translated_in_art_text: class ruling (upper, roberto-internal 93504): text drawn inside the illustration and translated per language does not make a new design. Worked case OP12-098: jp base / jp _r1 / cn base are 53 / 47 / 67 bits whole-card and 41 / 33 / 49 bits art-crop from the en base design. Second case OP12-078: jp base 42 bits whole-card / 32 art-crop, cn base 48 / 33.
method.sheets: contact sheets of art crops, each read under a 150KB image cap; sheet-2 stamp re-crops 74,945 and 26,600 bytes
method.stamp_region_check: where the first crop (art, y 12-60%) did not reach the stamp, the stamp's position was located by differencing the stamped tcgcsv image against the en base (both 600x838, 2px blur, 12x8 grid of mean abs diff): OP10-028 top cells y 50-66% x 62-100% (control, matches the visible stamp), OP12-085 top cells y 75-91% x 62-100%, below the art and under the text box. Each card was then re-cropped over that region and read.
method.stamp_region_rule: a stamp is not always inside the art: on OP12-085 it prints under the text box (y 75-91%), outside the y 12-60% art crop, so a fixed art crop would have read that stamped card as clean. Every stamp read therefore starts by locating the stamp: difference a stamped sibling against the unstamped one, confirm the method on a case where the stamp is visible (here OP10-028), and only then crop that region at resolution and read it.

parallel_lane.scope: every jp/cn printing of the 14 designed cards with no printing_design row at the start of the lane (53b3616): 19 printings, all parallels. The 5 held OP10 finish items sit on cards with no design and are out of scope by construction. 18 of the 19 have rows and 1 is parked (OP12-098 cn _02). The lane also writes one en row outside this scope: OP12-098 en _p1, which founds the second-illustration design that the jp _p1 and cn _01 join.
parallel_lane.hash_role: the hash proposes only. It cannot carry a verdict across cards: 60 art bits was a join on OP10-028 cn _01, and 56/58 was a split on OP10-033 jp _p1.
parallel_lane.image_diff: mean abs diff on a 12x8 grid after a 2px blur, both images at 600x838; the MEDIAN cell separates same image from different image. Same art: 0-4 for jp vs en (OP10-028 jp _p1 vs en _p1 = 4), 2-13 for cn because cn is upscaled from 454x635. Different art: OP10-033 jp _p1 vs en _p1 = 18, vs cn _01 = 17. Hot cells at y41-58 are the per-site SAMPLE watermark.
parallel_lane.stamp_regions: located per card by diff before any crop. Release Event (OP10): y50-66 x62-100, control OP10-028. CHAMPIONSHIP 25-26 (OP10-033 en _p1 Top Player vs _p2 Finalist): y58-66 x50-100. 4th Anniversary (OP17): 006/070/088 y66-91 x75-100, 025/045 y41-66 x75-100, 107 y66-83 x75-100.
parallel_lane.op10_033: cn _01 is the championship illustration (median cell 2 to en _p1 and _p2) with no stamp, so it is its own unstamped design, and the first language-exclusive design in the data (upper 93594). jp _p1 is a third illustration (median 18 / 17 against the same-art control of 4) with no stamp; the eye and the diff median decided it, the hash only proposed.
parallel_lane.op12_098_cn_02: prt_eykqpay2423a (cn _02, starter deck STC35&33, product cn:129) is PARKED on the exception list (upper 93632, 93645): the label says parallel and the image says base (every grid cell within 2 of cn base prt_h7gzncavwgur). On cn the label is the only signal, and it is wrong in both directions: a cn reprint can land as a second base (106 cards carry two or more cn base printings) or, as here, as a parallel token on the base image.
parallel_lane.op12_098_p1: en _p1, jp _p1 and cn _01 are one second illustration with translated in-art text (diff median cell 6 / 6, cn vs jp 3; en _p1 vs en base 57; same-art reference on this card 8 / 11). No stamp in y50-58 x62-100 on any of the three, read against the stamped tcgcsv control on the same sheet.
